detail.longDescription: I'm Marc Duiker, Dapr community manager and developer advocate at Diagrid (a company founded by the co-creators of the Dapr OSS project). I've created a new free local dashboard for Dapr developers that provides insights into everything they need: applications, sidecars, components, Dapr workflow instances and execution history, actors, state management, pub/sub subscriptions, logs, and two wizard-style UI builders for creating component files and resiliency policies (no more writing YAML by hand!). I think it's a very useful companion when doing local Dapr development, especially when developing workflow applications. Please give it a try and let me know what you think! There's also a built-in Easter egg; try typing the Konami code! ;)
